## Review Calculus

### 1. Differentiation
  	
a. Find the equation of the tangent line to the curve $\displaystyle y = 2x^3 - x^2 + 3$ at the point where $x = 1$.
\vfill
  
b. Determine the critical points and their concavity of the function $\displaystyle f(t) = t e^{(-t^2)}$.
\vfill

\newpage

### 2. Integration
  
a. Integrate $\displaystyle \int x \left(\ln{(x)}\right)^2 dx$ using integration by parts.
\vfill
  
b. Use integration by parts and limits to show that $\displaystyle \int_{1}^{\infty} \frac{\ln{(t)}}{t^2} dt = 1$ is true.
\vfill
